title: Ned Swims Best
note: b415 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters st, sw, tr.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling trotting along the grassy bank towards the pond.
Ned the duckling swimming across the calm pond, a gentle ripple behind him.
Close view of Ned the duckling lifting one soft, flat orange foot out of the water.
Underwater side view of Ned the duckling's flat feet kicking fast.
Ned the duckling swimming steadily across the wide pond.
Ned the duckling floating still on the surface of the pond, wings folded in.
Ned the duckling resting on a sunny patch of the bank, eyes half closed.
Underwater view of a duckling's webbed feet kicking strongly through the water.
Ned the duckling swimming happily near the green reeds at the edge of the pond.
